summary.ru: Тао-Кларджетское княжество — средневековое грузинское феодальное государство в Закавказье, с центром в Артануджи. Существовало между IX и XI веками.
summary.en: The Kingdom of the Iberians was a medieval Georgian monarchy under the Bagrationi dynasty which emerged circa 888 AD, succeeding the Principality of Iberia, in historical region of Tao-Klarjeti, or upper Iberia in north-eastern Turkey as well parts of modern southwestern Georgia, that stretched from the Iberian gates in the south and to the Lesser Caucasus in the north.
